channel.title: The Quillmark
channel.description: Housing, tech, gaming, streaming, home repair and deals news in one front page, with every story linked to its source.

item.title: Adobe expects Black Friday online sales of $12.9 billion, growing faster than Cyber Monday
item.description: Adobe's holiday forecast puts U.S. online spending at a record $275.1 billion for November and December, with the deepest discounts during Cyber Week.

item.title: Walmart's first Black Friday deals event starts November 12
item.description: Walmart is running three holiday sale events this year: early deals Nov. 12 to 15, Black Friday deals Nov. 23 to 29 and Cyber Monday deals Nov. 30 to Dec. 2.

item.title: Spotify reaches 306 million paying subscribers and 788 million users
item.description: Spotify's third-quarter results show growth in every region, with revenue of 5.0 billion euros and operating income ahead of its own forecast.

item.title: Pikmin 4 Switch 2 Edition with Dandori Academy arrives November 12
item.description: Nintendo's upgraded Pikmin 4 adds sharper visuals, voice commands for Oatchi and a 72-stage challenge mode released over time.

item.title: Football Manager 27 is out on PC, consoles, Netflix and Apple Arcade
item.description: Sports Interactive released all four versions of FM27 on November 10, including through Game Pass, Netflix and Apple Arcade subscriptions.

item.title: Chrome 157 update fixes a flaw Google says is being exploited
item.description: Google's November 9 desktop update patches nine security bugs, including a high-severity use-after-free in Chrome's XML code with a known exploit.

item.title: Windows 11 November update KB5132061 turns on NTLM signing by default
item.description: Microsoft's November security update for Windows 11 tightens NTLM and PowerShell script signing and fixes USB audio and printer bugs.

item.title: Home improvement spending expected to stay flat through late 2027
item.description: Harvard's remodeling forecast projects 1.5% growth to about $527 billion, citing flat building-product sales and stalled remodeling permits.

item.title: EIA: heating oil bills to rise 21% this winter while natural gas bills fall 9%
item.description: The federal energy agency's winter outlook splits sharply by fuel, so what a household pays depends on how the home is heated.

item.title: Homes for sale rose 7.4% in October as contract signings fell 17%
item.description: Realtor.com's October report shows more listings sitting on the market and fewer buyers signing contracts as mortgage rates held above 7%.

item.title: Skydance plans a combined Paramount+ and HBO Max streamer for early 2027
item.description: The company told shareholders the merged service would come at one price. It did not give the price.

item.title: Denver launches an AI tool that pre-checks building permit applications
item.description: StartSmart flags missing items before an application goes to city staff. Staff still make the final call.

item.title: Walmart raises prices on its onn Google TV streamers by $10
item.description: Walmart's onn Google TV lineup now costs $10 more per device, with the 4K Pro at $69.98 and the Full HD stick at $39.98.

item.title: OpenAI agrees to acquire Pierre, maker of Code Storage, to build out Codex
item.description: Pierre's open-source developer libraries will stay open source, and current Code Storage customers can keep using it after the deal closes.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is 10 days out: what to know about the Nov. 19 launch
item.description: Rockstar's release date has held since it moved from May, making it the biggest game launch of the holiday season.

item.title: Mortgage rates dip to 7.18% in Freddie Mac's Nov. 5 survey
item.description: The 30-year fixed average fell for a third straight week, but it is still almost a full point above where it sat a year ago.

item.title: Amazon's 2026 holiday return window runs to Jan. 31, 2027
item.description: Most items bought on Amazon from Nov. 1 through Dec. 31, 2026 can be returned through Jan. 31, 2027, per Amazon's return policy page. Apple-brand products have an earlier Jan. 15 deadline.

item.title: Existing-home sales rose 1.5% in September as inventory climbed
item.description: NAR counted a 3.99 million annual sales pace, with the median price up 1.3% from a year earlier to $417,500.

item.title: NRF forecasts 2026 holiday sales will top $1 trillion
item.description: The retail trade group expects November and December sales to grow 4.2% over 2025, with up to 375,000 seasonal hires.

item.title: Google AI Plus subscribers lose Pro model choice in AI Mode on November 13
item.description: Starting November 13, 2026, Google AI Plus subscribers can only pick Flash and Flash-Lite models in the Gemini app and in AI Mode in Google Search. Pro model selection moves to the Google AI Pro plan and above.

item.title: SAG-AFTRA adds a pitch agreement for indie game demos
item.description: A new union agreement lets small developers hire SAG-AFTRA performers for demos and vertical slices made to raise funding, with negotiable pitch fees.

item.title: 30-year mortgage rate eases to 7.18%, third weekly decline
item.description: Freddie Mac's weekly survey put the average 30-year fixed rate at 7.18% on November 5, down from 7.24% a week earlier but up from 6.22% a year ago.

item.title: Little Giant recalls about 3.66 million ladders with Rapid Locks over fall hazard
item.description: The CPSC and Little Giant announced a recall of about 3.66 million ladders with Rapid Locks because they can suddenly retract if the locks are not fully engaged. Owners should stop using them and contact Little Giant for a repair kit.

item.title: Nintendo reports higher first-half profit on lower sales
item.description: Nintendo's April to September net profit rose 11% to 220.9 billion yen while sales fell 12% to 966 billion yen.

item.title: Baby Brezza recalls SuperFast sterilizer dryers over overheating
item.description: About 29,000 Baby Brezza SuperFast sterilizer dryers can overheat while plugged in and running, posing a burn hazard, the CPSC says. Baby Brezza is offering free replacements.

item.title: Bose recalls S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ speaker battery packs over fire risk
item.description: About 634,759 lithium-ion battery packs for Bose S1 Pro and S1 Pro+ portable Bluetooth speakers can overheat and ignite, the CPSC says. Bose is offering free replacement packs.

item.title: Gourmia recalls about 175,951 9-slice digital air fryer ovens
item.description: The doors on Gourmia 9-slice digital air fryer ovens can close unexpectedly when bumped, posing a burn hazard, the CPSC says. Gourmia is mailing free repair kits.

item.title: Little Giant recalls about 3.66 million ladders with Rapid Locks
item.description: The CPSC says Little Giant ladders with Rapid Locks can suddenly retract if the locks are not fully engaged, posing a fall hazard. Owners should stop using them and get a repair kit.

item.title: Oklahoma voters reject SQ 847, keeping the 3% and 5% property value caps
item.description: State Question 847, which would have cut Oklahoma's yearly cap on taxable value growth from 3% to 1.75% for homesteads and ag land and from 5% to 4% for other property, failed on November 3.

item.title: HubSpot reports Q3 2026 revenue of $947.6 million, up 17%
item.description: HubSpot's third quarter 2026 revenue was $947.6 million, up 17% year over year, and it ended September with 311,704 customers, according to its results release filed with the SEC.

item.title: Xbox names six Indie Selects for November 2026
item.description: The ID@Xbox team picked six indie games for November, including Graveyard Keeper 2, Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 and Ratatan.

item.title: Toy maker Takara Tomy launches Enjoyn Games, an indie publishing label
item.description: Takara Tomy has entered game publishing with Enjoyn Games and three party titles for Steam, starting with a burger-stacking social deduction game.

item.title: Quebec holds its first Buy a Quebec Video Game Day on November 14
item.description: La Guilde du jeu video du Quebec is promoting games made in the province with a one-day event and a portal listing more than 400 titles.

item.title: HubSpot sets February 2027 shutdown for design manager serverless functions
item.description: HubSpot is retiring serverless functions built in the design manager and Node.js 20 and earlier for workflow custom code actions. Existing design manager functions stop running on February 1, 2027.

item.title: Indie publisher says 11,000 wishlists turned into a 15-player peak
item.description: Publisher 2 Left Thumbs blamed a Steam approval delay and a flood of low-effort AI games after Wheel Make It peaked at 15 concurrent players.

item.title: CPSC warns two sets of combination smoke and CO alarms sold online fail to alarm
item.description: The CPSC told consumers to stop using JuzhiAnn, Yfwsrecinoe and JAEHSKA alarms (model JZA-540COM) and GuardianSense/KLTseanife alarms (model YHW-542COM-R) because they fail to sound in the presence of smoke and fire. The sellers have not agreed to recalls.

item.title: DREO recalls about 338,800 DR-HSH015 ceramic space heaters for fire risk
item.description: DREO recalled about 338,800 DR-HSH015 ceramic space heaters made from April 2025 through January 2026 because they can overheat and ignite. Stop using them and contact DREO for a free replacement.

item.title: Amazon's Alexa for Shopping shows 30-, 90- and 365-day price history
item.description: Amazon's updated guide to its Alexa for Shopping assistant says it shows price history over 30, 90 and 365 days and can set price alerts or auto-buy at a target price.

item.title: Amazon confirms Black Friday on Nov. 27 and Cyber Monday on Nov. 30
item.description: Amazon's holiday guide confirms the 2026 Black Friday and Cyber Monday dates and says early deals are already live in its Holiday Shop. It has not yet posted Black Friday Week event dates.

item.title: Fed holds its target range at 3.75% to 4%, with two votes for a hike
item.description: The Federal Open Market Committee left the federal funds target range at 3-3/4 to 4 percent on October 28; Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissented in favor of a quarter-point increase.
